AliExpress is offering some solid gaming deals during its early Black Friday Sale, especially if you're a first time Aliexpress customer. For example, new AliExpress customers can pick up a brand new Nintendo Switch 2 console for $397.64 after $90 off coupon code " USAFF90 ". It ships free locally from the United States with no import fees and quick delivery. The vendor, Lucky Tech Store, is a legitimate seller of gaming consoles, including the Switch 2, Playstation 5, and Xbox.

Usually AliExpress sells international version of the Switch 2 console. However, according to the description, this particular console in a US model. That means setting up your Nintendo account is a snap because everything is in English and the packaging includes a US plug. You may also get a US-based Nintendo warranty starting from the manufacture date.

Nintendo Switch 2 Console (USA Model) for $398

The Nintendo Switch 2 console first released back in June of 2025 at a starting MSRP of $450. After the recent Nintendo price hike, the price went up $500. By now, upgrading from the Switch to the Switch 2 is a no-brainer. Several Switch 2 exclusives have been released including Mario Kart World, Donkey Kong Bananza, Pokemon Pokopia, Kirby Air Riders, Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, and more. Zelda: Ocarina of Time is out on Thursday, November 5 and IGN's Logan Plant gave it a glowing review.

Triple-A ports have also made their way to the Switch 2 console, including Cyberpunk 2077 and Final Fantasy VII Remake, making the Switch 2 a veritable competitor to pricier handheld gaming PCs. The Switch 2 hardware is powerful enough to run these games at a very playable clip, a feat that's impossible on the original Switch's hardware.
